    At most 2^κ modules of dimension κ #

    Let A be a finite-dimensional algebra over a field k, and κ ≥ |k| an infinite cardinal. Pairwise non-isomorphic A-modules of dimension κ form a family of cardinality at most 2^κ (card_le_two_pow_of_pairwise_not_iso), as in the proof of Corollary 5.7: a vector space Y of dimension κ has κ elements, so there are at most κ^κ = 2^κ linear endomorphisms of Y, and an A-module structure on Y is determined by the action of a finite basis of A.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.map_smul_of_basis {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type u} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] {M N : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module k M] [IsScalarTower k A M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module k N] [IsScalarTower k A N] {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι k A) (φ : M →ₗ[k] N) (h : ∀ (l : ι) (m : M), φ (b l • m) = b l • φ m) (a : A) (m : M) :
    φ (a • m) = a • φ m

    A k-linear bijection between A-modules that commutes with the action of a k-basis of A is A-linear.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.card_le_two_pow_of_pairwise_not_iso {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type u} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] (κ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ) (hk : Cardinal.mk k ≤ κ) {ι : Type u} (M : ι → Type u) [(i : ι) → AddCommGroup (M i)] [(i : ι) → Module A (M i)] [(i : ι) → Module k (M i)] [∀ (i : ι), IsScalarTower k A (M i)] (hni : ∀ (i j : ι), Nonempty (M i ≃ₗ[A] M j) → i = j) (hdim : ∀ (i : ι), Module.rank k (M i) = κ) :
    Cardinal.mk ι ≤ 2 ^ κ

    At most 2^κ pairwise non-isomorphic A-modules of dimension κ ≥ |k|.
